metadata.question: Did Lake Menindee, Australia shrink from January 27, 2017 to February 2, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Lake Menindee, Australia (approximately -32.4°S, 142.4°E) - Dates: January 27, 2017 and February 2, 2019 - Collection: Sentinel-2 for both dates (launched mid-2015), or Landsat 8 as fallback - Use NDWI or water classification to detect water extent 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds to get accurate water extent - Use QA bands for cloud masking - Question is about lake size, not clouds 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Lake genuinely has 0 water pixels (dried up) - this is a valid result - C2: No valid pixels after cloud masking (all clouds, can't see surface) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid value - Compare water pixel counts between two dates to determine if shrinkage occurred ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Lake Menindee location const lakeMenindee = ee.Geometry.Point([142.4, -32.4]); const region = lakeMenindee.buffer(15000); // 15km buffer to cover lake area // 2. Date definitions const date1 = '2017-01-27'; const date2 = '2019-02-02'; const dateRange = 15; // days before/after to find images // 3. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 4. Get Sentinel-2 images for both dates const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(ee.Date(date1).advance(-dateRange, 'day'), ee.Date(date1).advance(dateRange, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(ee.Date(date2).advance(-dateRange, 'day'), ee.Date(date2).advance(dateRange, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2017 Images: ${size1}, 2019 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("Trying Landsat 8 fallback..."); function maskL8clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } const l8col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(ee.Date(date1).advance(-dateRange, 'day'), ee.Date(date1).advance(dateRange, 'day')) .map(maskL8clouds); const l8col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(ee.Date(date2).advance(-dateRange, 'day'), ee.Date(date2).advance(dateRange, 'day')) .map(maskL8clouds); const l8size1 = await l8col1.size().getInfo(); const l8size2 = await l8col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 2017: ${l8size1}, Landsat 2019: ${l8size2}`); if (l8size1 === 0 || l8size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Use Landsat data const img1 = l8col1.median(); const img2 = l8col2.median(); const ndwi1 = img1.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B5']); const ndwi2 = img2.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B5']); const water1 = ndwi1.gt(0); const water2 = ndwi2.gt(0); const stats1 = await water1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await water2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels1 = stats1.nd_sum || 0; const waterPixels2 = stats2.nd_sum || 0; const validPixels1 = stats1.nd_count || 0; const validPixels2 = stats2.nd_count || 0; console.log(`2017: Water=${waterPixels1}, Valid=${validPixels1}`); console.log(`2019: Water=${waterPixels2}, Valid=${validPixels2}`); if (validPixels1 === 0 || validPixels2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (waterPixels2 < waterPixels1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } return; } // 5. Process Sentinel-2 data const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); // 6. Calculate NDWI (water index) const ndwi1 = img1.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']); const ndwi2 = img2.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']); // 7. Threshold to identify water (NDWI > 0) const water1 = ndwi1.gt(0); const water2 = ndwi2.gt(0); // 8. Count water pixels const stats1 = await water1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await water2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: region, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels1 = stats1.nd_sum || 0; const waterPixels2 = stats2.nd_sum || 0; const validPixels1 = stats1.nd_count || 0; const validPixels2 = stats2.nd_count || 0; console.log(`2017: Water=${waterPixels1}, Valid=${validPixels1}`); console.log(`2019: Water=${waterPixels2}, Valid=${validPixels2}`); // 9. Validation if (validPixels1 === 0 || validPixels2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (waterPixels1 === null || waterPixels2 === null) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 10. Compare water extent if (waterPixels2 < waterPixels1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
